verdicts.reason: A does rearrange for the taller canvas, but the logo is so huge it overpowers the headline. 'Silence, engineered' is small and jammed about 12px from the left edge, while the Shop button sits about 75px in from the right, so the bottom row has uneven margins. B is just the original strip shrunk and centred, leaving roughly 40% dead space above and below, with the Shop button almost touching the right edge. A is slightly less bad because it at least fills and adapts to the format.
